name: Ashita e no Okurimono ~Gift to your future~
original_name: 明日へのおくりもの  ～Gift to your future～
source:
"Hajimemashite, Master."
"I wanted to meet you for so long..."
"This song is just for you."

I met her on the first night of snowfall.
We made winter memories that will last forever.

"Thank you, Master." *weep*
"I, this place is something I will treasure."
"I'll remember this for all time." 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE099477.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“初次见面，主人。”“我想见你很久了……”“这首歌只为你而唱。”

我在初雪之夜遇见了她。我们创造了永远珍藏的冬日回忆。

“谢谢你，主人。”*哭泣*“我，这个地方我会珍惜的。”“我会永远记住这一切。”

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE099477.html]DLsite English[/url]]
